quote: The prima facie speed limit is twenty-five miles per hour on all streets and highways unless a different speed limit is posted as set forth in this Title.

activation.condition: Vehicle travels on a covered street or highway.

exceptions.description: A different speed limit posted as set forth in this Title.

obligation.description: Prima facie limit of 25 miles per hour absent a different applicable posting.
